evidence.detached_house: a detached house may be converted

calculation_handling.description: Permits converting a lawfully constructed (pre-December 15, 2023) detached house in the R zone to an apartment building by adding dwelling units entirely within the existing building, which keeps its lawfully existing status.
calculation_handling.gaps: Depends on the construction date and lawful status of the existing building, which we do not hold. The date December 15, 2023 is a date, not a numeric literal.

units.disclosure: Converting an existing detached house into an apartment building is allowed only for a house lawfully built before December 15, 2023, with all new units inside the existing building. We cannot confirm the building's history, so this is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Deeming rule: a detached house converted to an apartment building under (1) may still be treated as a detached house for the listed clauses and regulations (10.5.50.10, 10.5.80.10, 10.5.80.1(2), 10.10.40.10(2) and (11), 10.10.40.40(2), 10.10.80.1(1)(B), 200.5.10.1(1)).
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies only to an existing converted building; the deemed building type changes which regulations apply, which we cannot determine without the building's history. Cross-referenced regulation numbers are not literals.

units.disclosure: A converted detached house may keep being treated as a detached house for certain height, landscaping, coverage and parking rules. We cannot confirm whether a lot holds such a converted building.

evidence.semi_detached_house: a portion of a semi-detached house

calculation_handling.description: Permits converting one lot's portion of a semi-detached house to more than four dwelling units, still treated as a semi-detached house, if the building was lawfully constructed before December 15, 2023 and the new units are entirely within it.
calculation_handling.gaps: Depends on the construction date and lawful status of the existing building. 'more than four' describes the permitted conversion, not a lot condition, so it is listed as an application threshold rather than a condition.if.

units.disclosure: Converting one half of an existing semi-detached house to more than four units is allowed only if it was lawfully built before December 15, 2023 and all units are inside it. We cannot confirm the building's history.

calculation_handling.description: Deeming rule: the unconverted portion of the semi-detached house on the adjacent lot stays in the original building type for applying the by-law's standards.
calculation_handling.gaps: Requires knowing that the adjoining half of the semi-detached house was converted under (2); we do not hold that fact.

units.disclosure: If the other half of your semi-detached house was converted to many units, your half is still treated as a semi-detached house. We cannot confirm such a conversion.

evidence.apartment_building: considered to be an apartment building

calculation_handling.description: Deeming rule: for Clause 10.5.40.40 and Regulation 10.10.40.30(1), the converted portion (more than four units) of a semi-detached house may be treated as an apartment building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies only to an existing converted building; we do not hold conversion history. Cross-referenced regulation numbers are not literals.

units.disclosure: A semi-detached half converted to more than four units may be treated as an apartment building for certain depth and floor-area rules. We cannot confirm such a conversion.

calculation_handling.description: Deeming rule: if both halves of an originally semi-detached house are converted under this regulation, the building is still considered its original building type, subject to 10.10.20.41(4).
calculation_handling.gaps: Requires conversion history of both halves; not held.

units.disclosure: If both halves of a semi-detached house are converted, the building remains a semi-detached house for zoning purposes. We cannot confirm such a conversion.

calculation_handling.description: Any addition or extension to a lawfully existing building converted under (1) or (2) must comply with all other regulations or be authorized by a minor variance under Section 45 of the Planning Act.
calculation_handling.gaps: The unit text does not name a zone (the R zone is named only in (1) and (2)), so zones is left empty for lack of an evidence phrase. 'Section 45' is a statutory section number, not a literal.

units.disclosure: Additions to a converted, lawfully existing building must meet all other zoning rules or get a minor variance. We cannot confirm whether a building is such a converted building.

calculation_handling.description: Extends the meaning of 'lawful', 'lawfully' and 'lawfully existing' for the listed regulations to include buildings, structures or uses authorized or permitted on or before December 15, 2023.
calculation_handling.gaps: A definition of a status we do not hold; the date is not a numeric literal. No zone is named in the unit text.

calculation_handling.description: Extends the meaning of 'lawful', 'lawfully' and 'lawfully existing' for the listed regulations to include buildings for which a building permit was lawfully issued before December 15, 2023.
calculation_handling.gaps: A definition of a status we do not hold; the date is not a numeric literal. No zone is named in the unit text.

calculation_handling.description: Regulations 10.5.1.10(3) and 10.10.40.1(3) (dwelling-unit limits) do not apply to a lawfully existing detached house or semi-detached portion converted under 10.10.20.41(1) or (2).
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces 10.5.1.10(3) and 10.10.40.1(3) (the template has no displaces field; recorded here). Applies only to an existing converted building whose history we do not hold. No zone is named in the unit text.

units.disclosure: The usual limits on the number of dwelling units do not apply to a lawfully existing house converted under these rules. We cannot confirm whether a building qualifies.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 150.10.20.1(1) and (2), a secondary suite is not permitted in the portion of a semi-detached house converted to more than four dwelling units under 10.10.20.41(2).
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies only to a semi-detached portion already converted under (2); conversion history not held. No zone is named in the unit text. 'Despite regulations 150.10.20.1(1) and (2)' displaces the secondary-suite permission for this case only.

units.disclosure: A secondary suite is not allowed in a semi-detached half that has been converted to more than four units. We cannot confirm whether a building has been converted.

10.10.20.41(1).explanation: In the R zone, an existing detached house lawfully built before December 15, 2023 can be converted into a small apartment building by adding units entirely inside the existing building. It keeps its lawfully existing status and may still be treated as a detached house for several height, landscaping, coverage and parking rules.

10.10.20.41(2).explanation: In the R zone, one half of an existing semi-detached house lawfully built before December 15, 2023 can be converted to more than four units, with all units inside the existing building, and still count as a semi-detached house. The other half keeps its original building type; the converted half may be treated as an apartment building for certain depth and floor-area rules.

10.10.20.41(3).explanation: Any addition or extension to one of these converted buildings must meet all other zoning rules, or be approved through a minor variance.

10.10.20.41(4).explanation: For these conversion rules, 'lawfully existing' also covers buildings, structures or uses that were permitted on or before December 15, 2023, or that had a building permit lawfully issued before that date.

10.10.20.41(5).explanation: The general limits on the number of dwelling units on a lot do not apply to a lawfully existing detached house or semi-detached half converted under these rules.

10.10.20.41(6).explanation: A secondary suite is not allowed in a semi-detached half that has been converted to more than four units under these rules.
